timestamp_precision.sensor_telemetry: Exact hourly UTC/IST timestamp (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD HH:00:00)
timestamp_precision.image_metadata: Calendar date only (YYYY-MM-DD); 0% sub-daily timestamps available in manifest or EXIF
timestamp_precision.pairing_policy: Representative Midday Sensor Sequence (closest available target to 12:00 PM on matching date)

target_definitions.primary_sensor_target: Actual CPCB ground monitor PM2.5 measurement at target hour (mean: 133.51 ug/m3, std: 141.36 ug/m3)
target_definitions.image_static_label: PM25Vision web-scraped label (mean: 187.85 ug/m3, std: 64.02 ug/m3)

causal_alignment_limitation: Strict next-hour causal image fusion cannot be validated using the current PM25Vision dataset because image capture hours are missing. Pairing relies on representative midday 24-hour sequence alignment. This prototype demonstrates the complete working multimodal fusion neural architecture and its training/inference pipeline, but must not be represented as a validated operational next-hour forecast.
